intent: Which parts of the Module 1 skill a builder can reuse anywhere, and which are tied to the NovaSmart lab.

regions.contains: the title only, top-left, one line

regions.occupies: left half inside the margins, from 16% to 92% of the height
regions.contains: a soft blue panel (#E8F0FE fill, medium blue outline) with a heading and six stacked rows

regions.occupies: right half inside the margins, from 16% to 92% of the height
regions.contains: a light grey panel with a heading and three stacked rows

text_exact.text: What to take from this skill

text_exact.position: left row 4, icon: list with an arrow

text_exact.text: Prove it with a triggered denial

text_exact.position: right row 2, icon: simple outline bullseye target
right row 3, icon: page layout with three blocks

mandatory: The left panel is soft blue (working_system); the right panel is light grey (neutral)

Two panels of identical size side by side; each row is a white rounded strip with a small outline icon at its left; left-panel row text sits on one line; right-panel row text may wrap onto two lines, breaking only between words
The right panel's three rows are taller than the left rows and evenly spaced so the first row aligns with left row 1 and the last row aligns with left row 6; no empty lower half
The number in 'The 16-check list' is the digits 16
The title reads exactly 'What to take from this skill', bold, top-left, one line
Every string in text_exact appears exactly once, spelled exactly as written
prohibitions: NO green anywhere: no green fill, outline, icon or text
NO tick marks, crosses or X marks
NO person, head, crown or user icons
NO command text, shell syntax, flags or flag values of any kind (no 'gcloud', 'curl', 'bq', 'agy -p', '--', '$', '|', 'stream-json')
NO URLs, hostnames or file paths other than the file names listed in text_exact
NO project IDs, project numbers, regions, or email addresses (nothing containing '@', 'projects/' or 'iam.gserviceaccount.com')
NO logos of any kind, including Google, Google Cloud, Gemini or Antigravity logos
NO people, faces, hands, silhouettes, robots, mascots or characters
NO text that is not listed in text_exact: no extra labels, numbers, step numbers, captions, legend, footnote or source note
NO identifier (file name or login name) broken across two lines
NO word broken at a hyphen
NO grey or faint text for any label; every label is semibold near-black #1F2328
alt_text: What to take from this skill. A blue panel, Reusable anywhere: read before you write; one change, then re-read; every change has an undo; grant first, remove last; prove it with a triggered denial; never grant yourself a role. A gray panel, NovaSmart only: NovaSmart names and seed bucket; the 16-check list; Step 7 show formats.
